What is omacut?

Omacut is a bare-bones video trimmer built with Qt Quick and ffmpeg. You open a video, drag start and end handles to select the section you want, preview it, and export as MP4 at its original resolution, 1080p, or 720p, always keeping the original aspect ratio. It's built for quick trims rather than full editing, with keyboard shortcuts for playback, frame-stepping, and zooming.

Install omacut on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add omacut

Good to know

  • ffmpeg and ffprobe installed on PATH
  • xdg-desktop-portal with a backend for file selection
